We use the existing Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment across all expression-eligible motifs.

In [59]:
def adjust_bh(p_values):
    """BH adjustment"""
    p = np.asarray(p_values, dtype=float)
    if not np.isfinite(p).all() or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
        raise ValueError('Invalid p-values for BH correction')
    order = np.argsort(p, kind='stable')
    ranked = p[order] * len(p) / np.arange(1, len(p) + 1)
    corrected = np.minimum.accumulate(ranked[::-1])[::-1]
    result = np.empty_like(p)
    result[order] = np.minimum(corrected, 1)
    return result

The original two-sided Fisher test compares regions with and without each motif, with the 0.5 correction used only for plotting.

In [61]:
def test_motif_enrichment(differential_counts, background_counts, expression_annotation):
    """Test two-sided differences in region-level motif presence, including zero-hit motifs."""
    n_diff, n_bg = differential_counts.shape[0], background_counts.shape[0]
    if min(n_diff, n_bg) == 0 or differential_counts.shape[1] != len(motif_ids) or background_counts.shape[1] != len(motif_ids):
        raise ValueError('Empty groups or inconsistent motif matrix columns')
    a_values = np.asarray((differential_counts > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    c_values = np.asarray((background_counts > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    eligibility = expression_annotation.set_index('motif_id')['expressed_any_time']
    if eligibility.index.has_duplicates or set(eligibility.index) != set(motif_ids):
        raise ValueError('Expression eligibility must contain exactly one row per scanned motif')
    rows = []
    for motif_id, a, c in zip(motif_ids, a_values, c_values):
        a, c = int(a), int(c)
        b, d = n_diff - a, n_bg - c
        if eligibility.loc[motif_id]:
            odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='two-sided')
        else:
            odds_ratio, p_value = np.nan, np.nan
        correction = 0.5 if min(a, b, c, d) == 0 else 0.0
        plot_or = ((a + correction) * (d + correction)) / ((b + correction) * (c + correction))
        status = ('shared' if a > 0 and c > 0 else 'differential-only' if a > 0
                  else 'background-only' if c > 0 else 'not detected')
        rows.append({'motif_id': motif_id, 'differential_with_hit': a,
                     'differential_without_hit': b, 'background_with_hit': c,
                     'background_without_hit': d,
                     'differential_fraction': a / n_diff, 'background_fraction': c / n_bg,
                     'odds_ratio': odds_ratio, 'odds_ratio_plot': plot_or,
                     'zero_cell_correction': bool(correction), 'p_value': p_value,
                     'motif_status': status})
    results = pd.DataFrame(rows).merge(motif_annotations, on='motif_id', validate='one_to_one')
    results = results.merge(expression_annotation.drop(columns='TF'), on='motif_id', validate='one_to_one')
    eligible = results['expressed_any_time']
    results['q_value'] = np.nan
    if eligible.any():
        results.loc[eligible, 'q_value'] = adjust_bh(results.loc[eligible, 'p_value'])
    results['log2_odds_ratio_plot'] = np.log2(results['odds_ratio_plot'])
    results['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(results['p_value'].clip(lower=np.finfo(float).tiny))
    results['significant_enrichment'] = eligible & (results['q_value'] < fdr_threshold) & (results['odds_ratio'] > 1)
    results['label'] = results['TF'] + ' [' + results['motif_id'] + ']'
    return results.sort_values(['q_value', 'p_value', 'odds_ratio', 'motif_id'],
                               ascending=[True, True, False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, max(4, 0.25 * len(top_motifs) + 1.8)))
if top_motifs.empty:
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No expression-eligible motifs have raw p < 0.05',
            transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', va='center')
    ax.set_yticks([])
else:
    y = np.arange(len(top_motifs))
    ax.hlines(y, 0, top_motifs['log2_odds_ratio_plot'], color='#c7c7c7', linewidth=1.1)
    for bh_supported, color in [(False, '#dd8452'), (True, '#3274a1')]:
        for corrected, marker in [(False, 'o'), (True, '^')]:
            keep = top_motifs['bh_significant'].eq(bh_supported) & top_motifs['zero_cell_correction'].eq(corrected)
            ax.scatter(top_motifs.loc[keep, 'log2_odds_ratio_plot'], y[keep],
                       color=color, marker=marker, s=35, zorder=3)
    ax.set_yticks(y, top_motifs['label'], fontsize=8)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    legend = [Line2D([0], [0], color='#dd8452', marker='o', linestyle='', label='Raw p < 0.05 only'),
              Line2D([0], [0], color='#3274a1', marker='o', linestyle='', label='BH q < 0.05')]
    if top_motifs['zero_cell_correction'].any():
        legend.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#555555', marker='^', linestyle='',
                             label='0.5 correction for plotting only'))
    ax.legend(handles=legend, loc='best', fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(0, color='#555555', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.set_xlabel('log2(odds ratio): differential FIREs / background FIREs')
ax.set_title(f'Panel 2: footprint-supported motif enrichment (0 vs 15 min)\nTop {len(top_motifs)} by raw p-value; ≥50% motif overlap; both FIRE directions pooled')
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.2)

7. Define the requested TF example groups¶

Generate RELA, NFKB1, KLF12 and CTCF, ZNF131, ELK3 examples; display only RELA and ZNF131. KLF12 remains in the requested first plotting group, but its measured motif-enrichment direction is depleted (see the statistics below).

We use the specified TF order and one explicit JASPAR profile per TF, retaining enrichment statistics as annotations rather than using them to select or rank TFs.

In [72]:
if generate_example_plots:
    # The order below is user specified, not an ordering by motif p-value or BH q-value.
    example_directions = ['enriched', 'depleted']
    requested_profiles = {
        'enriched': [('RELA', 'MA0107.1'), ('NFKB1', 'MA0105.4'), ('KLF12', 'MA0742.2')],
        'depleted': [('CTCF', 'MA0139.2'), ('ZNF131', 'MA2546.1'), ('ELK3', 'MA0759.3')],
    }
    # CTCF uses the explicit MA0139.2 profile; its other profiles are not plotted.
    requested_example_motifs = pd.DataFrame([
        {'direction': direction, 'rank_within_direction': rank,
         'selection_TF': tf, 'selection_motif_id': motif}
        for direction, profiles in requested_profiles.items()
        for rank, (tf, motif) in enumerate(profiles, start=1)
    ])
    motif_statistics = enrichment_results[['motif_id', 'TF', 'q_value', 'p_value', 'odds_ratio']].rename(
        columns={'motif_id': 'selection_motif_id', 'TF': 'reported_TF',
                 'q_value': 'selection_motif_q_value', 'p_value': 'selection_motif_p_value',
                 'odds_ratio': 'selection_motif_odds_ratio'})
    requested_example_motifs = requested_example_motifs.merge(
        motif_statistics, on='selection_motif_id', how='left', validate='one_to_one', sort=False)
    assert requested_example_motifs['reported_TF'].notna().all(), 'A requested TF profile is absent from the tested motif results.'
    assert requested_example_motifs['selection_TF'].str.upper().eq(requested_example_motifs['reported_TF'].str.upper()).all()
    observed_effect = np.where(requested_example_motifs['selection_motif_odds_ratio'].gt(1), 'enriched', 'depleted')
    requested_example_motifs['observed_motif_effect'] = observed_effect
    # Requested plotting groups are distinct from measured enrichment direction.
    mismatch = requested_example_motifs.loc[requested_example_motifs['direction'].ne(observed_effect)]
    if not mismatch.empty:
        print('Requested group differs from measured enrichment for:', ', '.join(mismatch.selection_TF))
        display(mismatch[['selection_TF', 'direction', 'observed_motif_effect', 'selection_motif_odds_ratio', 'selection_motif_q_value']])
    requested_example_motifs = requested_example_motifs.drop(columns='reported_TF')
    requested_example_motifs.to_csv(tables_dir / 'requested_example_motifs.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

    # FIRE BH values annotate the FIRE track and do not rank the TFs or their regions.
    fire_q_by_region = pd.Series(adjust_bh(pairwise_0_15['p_value']), index=pairwise_0_15['region_id'])
    rank_columns = ['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'region_id', 'freq_0', 'freq_15',
                    'delta_freq_15_minus_0', 'log2_or', 'p_value']
    region_candidates = pairwise_fire_regions_differential.loc[
        pairwise_fire_regions_differential['delta_freq_15_minus_0'].ne(0), rank_columns
    ].copy()
    region_candidates['fire_direction'] = np.where(region_candidates['delta_freq_15_minus_0'].gt(0), 'increased', 'decreased')
    region_candidates['fire_q_value'] = region_candidates['region_id'].map(fire_q_by_region)
    assert region_candidates['fire_q_value'].notna().all()
    count_region_ids = regions_by_group['differential'].loc[analysis_masks['differential'], 'region_id'].to_numpy()
    assert len(count_region_ids) == counts_by_group['differential'].shape[0]
    assert len(motif_ids) == counts_by_group['differential'].shape[1]
    motif_column_indices = pd.Index(motif_ids).get_indexer(requested_example_motifs['selection_motif_id'])
    assert (motif_column_indices >= 0).all()
    present = counts_by_group['differential'][:, motif_column_indices].tocoo()
    motif_region_hits = pd.DataFrame({
        'region_id': count_region_ids[present.row],
        'selection_motif_id': requested_example_motifs['selection_motif_id'].to_numpy()[present.col],
        'selection_motif_hit_count': present.data,
    })
    ranked_regions = (motif_region_hits
        .merge(requested_example_motifs, on='selection_motif_id', validate='many_to_one')
        .merge(region_candidates, on='region_id', validate='many_to_one')
        .sort_values(['direction', 'rank_within_direction', 'p_value', 'chrom', 'start', 'end', 'region_id'],
                     kind='stable').reset_index(drop=True))
    ranked_regions.to_csv(tables_dir / 'ranked_differential_regions.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    display(requested_example_motifs)
    print('Candidate motif-region pairs:', len(ranked_regions))
    print('Each requested TF receives its strongest remaining differential FIRE by raw Fisher p-value, then coordinates.')

8. Select one distinct FIRE region for each requested TF¶

We select the requested TF examples, first examine a ±500 bp window around each FIRE midpoint, then center the final ±500 bp window on its most footprint-supported motif hit.

In [75]:
if generate_example_plots:
    n_examples_per_direction = 3
    example_exclusions = pd.DataFrame([
        {'region_id': 'chr16:28141068-28141263',
         'reason': 'User exclusion: missing segment in the read'},
        {'region_id': 'chr4:112284963-112285236',
         'reason': 'User exclusion: remove this example and its associated plots'},
    ])
    example_exclusions.to_csv(tables_dir / 'excluded_example_regions.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    excluded_region_ids = set(example_exclusions['region_id'])
    eligible_example_regions = ranked_regions.loc[~ranked_regions['region_id'].isin(excluded_region_ids)].copy()
    eligible_example_regions.to_csv(tables_dir / 'eligible_ranked_example_regions.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    selected_rows, used_regions = [], set()
    for requested in requested_example_motifs.itertuples(index=False):
        candidates = eligible_example_regions.loc[
            eligible_example_regions['selection_motif_id'].eq(requested.selection_motif_id)
            & ~eligible_example_regions['region_id'].isin(used_regions)
        ]
        if candidates.empty:
            raise ValueError(f'No distinct eligible FIRE region remains for {requested.selection_TF}')
        row = candidates.iloc[0]
        selected_rows.append(row)
        used_regions.add(row['region_id'])
    selected_examples = pd.DataFrame(selected_rows).reset_index(drop=True)
    assert len(selected_examples) == 2 * n_examples_per_direction
    assert selected_examples.groupby('direction').size().eq(n_examples_per_direction).all()
    assert not selected_examples['region_id'].duplicated().any()
    assert not selected_examples['region_id'].isin(excluded_region_ids).any()
    assert selected_examples['selection_motif_hit_count'].gt(0).all()
    assert selected_examples['selection_TF'].tolist() == requested_example_motifs['selection_TF'].tolist()
    selected_examples['example_id'] = selected_examples['direction'] + '_' + selected_examples['rank_within_direction'].astype(str)

    def example_folder_name(example_id, region_id):
        direction, rank = example_id.rsplit('_', 1)
        region_label = re.sub(r'[:-]', '_', region_id)
        return f'{direction}_rank{int(rank):02d}_{region_label}'

    example_folder_names = {
        row.example_id: example_folder_name(row.example_id, row.region_id)
        for row in selected_examples.itertuples(index=False)
    }

    def example_directory(example_id):
        return example_root / example_folder_names[example_id]

    # First identify footprints in a +/-500 bp window around the FIRE midpoint.
    example_flank_bp = 500
    selected_examples['fire_midpoint'] = ((selected_examples['start'] + 1 + selected_examples['end']) // 2).astype(int)
    selected_examples['window_center'] = selected_examples['fire_midpoint']
    selected_examples['window_start'] = selected_examples['window_center'] - example_flank_bp
    selected_examples['window_end'] = selected_examples['window_center'] + example_flank_bp
    assert selected_examples['window_start'].gt(0).all()
    selected_examples['initial_window_start'] = selected_examples['window_start']
    selected_examples['initial_window_end'] = selected_examples['window_end']
    selected_examples['window_coordinate_system'] = '1-based inclusive; center +/-500 bp (1001 bases)'
    selected_examples.to_csv(tables_dir / 'selected_example_regions.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    for row in selected_examples.itertuples(index=False):
        example_directory(row.example_id).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    display(example_exclusions)
    display(selected_examples[['example_id', 'region_id', 'selection_TF', 'selection_motif_id',
                               'selection_motif_q_value', 'fire_direction', 'p_value']])
    print('Selected one distinct region for each requested TF, keeping the specified TF order.')

    # The original FIMO scan covers FIRE intervals only; flanking sequence is not rescanned.
    track_motifs = enrichment_results.loc[
        enrichment_results['motif_id'].isin(selected_examples['selection_motif_id']),
        ['motif_id', 'TF', 'q_value', 'odds_ratio']
    ].rename(columns={'q_value': 'motif_q_value'})
    track_motifs['motif_effect'] = np.where(track_motifs['odds_ratio'].gt(1), 'enriched', 'depleted')
    hit_parts = []
    for chunk in pd.read_csv(fimo_root / 'fimo_differential/fimo.tsv', sep='\t', comment='#',
                             usecols=['motif_id', 'sequence_name', 'start', 'stop', 'strand', 'score', 'p-value'],
                             chunksize=250_000):
        chunk = chunk.loc[chunk['motif_id'].isin(track_motifs['motif_id'])].copy()
        left = chunk[['start', 'stop']].min(axis=1)
        right = chunk[['start', 'stop']].max(axis=1)
        chunk['bed_start'] = left if fasta_headers_use_bed_start else left - 1
        chunk['bed_end'] = right + 1 if fasta_headers_use_bed_start else right
        for ex in selected_examples.itertuples(index=False):
            hits = chunk.loc[chunk['motif_id'].eq(ex.selection_motif_id)
                             & chunk['sequence_name'].eq(ex.chrom)
                             & chunk['bed_start'].ge(ex.start) & chunk['bed_end'].le(ex.end)].copy()
            if hits.empty:
                continue
            supported = footprint_support.supported_motifs(
                hits['bed_start'].to_numpy(), hits['bed_end'].to_numpy(), footprint_index[ex.chrom])
            hits = hits.loc[supported].copy()
            if hits.empty:
                continue
            hits['example_id'], hits['region_id'] = ex.example_id, ex.region_id
            hits['start'], hits['end'] = hits['bed_start'] + 1, hits['bed_end']
            hit_parts.append(hits[['example_id', 'region_id', 'motif_id', 'start', 'end', 'strand', 'score', 'p-value']])
    if not hit_parts:
        raise ValueError('No FIMO hits found for the motif-selected regions')
    example_motif_hits = (pd.concat(hit_parts, ignore_index=True)
        .rename(columns={'p-value': 'fimo_p_value'})
        .merge(track_motifs.drop(columns='odds_ratio'), on='motif_id', validate='many_to_one')
        .sort_values(['example_id', 'motif_q_value', 'motif_id', 'start', 'end', 'strand']))
    assert np.isfinite(example_motif_hits['score']).all()
    for ex in selected_examples.itertuples(index=False):
        hits = example_motif_hits.loc[example_motif_hits['example_id'].eq(ex.example_id)]
        assert hits['start'].ge(ex.start + 1).all() and hits['end'].le(ex.end).all()
        assert hits['motif_id'].eq(ex.selection_motif_id).all()
        assert len(hits) == ex.selection_motif_hit_count
    example_motif_hits.to_csv(tables_dir / 'example_motif_hits.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    display(example_motif_hits.head())
    print('Each example shows only its requested TF motif; motif and FIRE BH values annotate separate tests.')

if generate_example_plots:
    r_common = r"""
    suppressPackageStartupMessages({
      library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(Matrix)
      library(GenomicRanges); library(Rsamtools); library(data.table)
      library(igraph); library(ComplexHeatmap); library(cowplot); library(grid)
      library(patchwork)
    })
    project_root <- Sys.getenv("FIRE_PROJECT_ROOT")
    output_root <- Sys.getenv("FIRE_0_15_OUTPUT")
    tables_dir <- file.path(output_root, "tables")
    example_root <- file.path(output_root, "example_regions")
    source(file.path(project_root, "code/topic_model/topic_modelling_functions.r"))
    source(file.path(project_root, "code/clustering_methods/Leiden_Manhattan/leiden_manhattan_functions.r"))
    source(file.path(project_root, "code/clustering_methods/Leiden_Manhattan/leiden_manhattan_plots.r"))
    source(file.path(project_root, "code/topic_model/read_region_extraction/region_data_utils.R"))
    source(file.path(project_root, "code/topic_model/read_region_extraction/region_plot_functions.R"))
    options(scipen = 999)
    set.seed(1)
    examples <- read.delim(file.path(tables_dir, "selected_example_regions.tsv"), check.names = FALSE)
    n_per_direction <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("FIRE_EXAMPLES_PER_DIRECTION", "5"))
    excluded_examples <- read.delim(file.path(tables_dir, "excluded_example_regions.tsv"))
    stopifnot(nrow(examples) == 2L * n_per_direction, !anyDuplicated(examples$example_id),
              all(table(examples$direction) == n_per_direction),
              !any(examples$region_id %in% excluded_examples$region_id))
    sample_table <- data.frame(sample_name = c("LPS_0", "LPS_5", "LPS_10", "LPS_15"),
                               condition = "LPS", timepoint = c(0L, 5L, 10L, 15L))
    sample_names <- sample_table$sample_name
    ft_result_dir <- file.path(project_root, "macrophage_project/FiberHMM/extract/ft_result_dir")
    window_size <- 0L
    k_neighbors <- 10L
    leiden_resolution <- 1
    leiden_seed <- 1L
    kernel_sigma <- NULL
    impute_missing <- FALSE
    impute_k <- 5L
    line_smooth_k <- 1L
    # Keep original direction ranks and genomic region IDs in output names.
    example_output_name <- function(ex) {
      sprintf("%s_rank%02d_%s", ex$direction, as.integer(ex$rank_within_direction),
              gsub("[:-]", "_", ex$region_id))
    }
    example_dir <- function(ex) {
      path <- file.path(example_root, example_output_name(ex))
      dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      path
    }
    example_figure_path <- function(ex, panel, description) {
      filename <- paste0(panel, "_", example_output_name(ex), "_", description, ".pdf")
      file.path(example_dir(ex), filename)
    }
    write_tsv <- function(x, path) {
      # Keep tabular exports in the shared tables directory, never example folders.
      destination <- normalizePath(dirname(path), mustWork = TRUE)
      allowed <- normalizePath(tables_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
      if (!identical(destination, allowed)) stop("TSV output must be in tables_dir: ", path)
      write.table(x, path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
    }
    read_result <- function(ex) readRDS(file.path(example_dir(ex), "pooled_leiden.rds"))
    region_title <- function(ex) paste0(ex$example_id, " | ", ex$region_id,
                                       " | 15 - 0 min delta = ", signif(ex$delta_freq_15_minus_0, 3))
    show_reads <- function(result) {
      print(head(result$assignments[, c("RID", "sample_name", "timepoint", "cluster")]))
      print(table(factor(result$assignments$sample_name, levels = sample_names)))
    }
    """

    def run_r_stage(name, body):
        """Save each R script and stream its output to the notebook without log files."""
        script_path = r_scripts_dir / f"{name}.R"
        script_path.write_text(r_common + "\n" + body + "\n")
        with subprocess.Popen(
            [rscript, "--vanilla", str(script_path)], env=r_environment,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True,
        ) as process:
            for line in process.stdout:
                if ".pdf" not in line:
                    print(line, end="", flush=True)
            return_code = process.wait()
        if return_code:
            raise RuntimeError(f"R stage {name} failed with exit status {return_code}; see notebook output above.")

    run_r_stage("00_check_leiden_inputs", r"""
    print(sample_table)
    print(examples[, c("example_id", "region_id", "window_start", "window_end")])
    for (chrom in unique(examples$chrom)) {
      paths <- file.path(ft_result_dir, sample_names, "extracted_results", "m6a_by_chr",
                         paste0(sample_names, ".ft_extracted_m6a.", chrom, ".bed.gz"))
      required <- c(paths, paste0(paths, ".tbi"))
      if (!all(file.exists(required))) stop("Missing m6A files: ", paste(required[!file.exists(required)], collapse = ", "))
    }
    print(sessionInfo())
    cat("All", nrow(examples), "selected regions have indexed m6A inputs for every timepoint.\n")
    """)

10. Extract the 0-, 5-, 10-, and 15-minute molecules¶

Here we extract the initial FIRE-midpoint windows to identify eligible molecules before selecting a motif-supported center.

In [83]:
if generate_example_plots:
    def extract_pooled_m6a():
        run_r_stage("01_extract_pooled_m6a", r"""
        input_summary <- list()
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {
          ex <- examples[i, , drop = FALSE]
          cat("\nExtracting", ex$example_id, ex$region_id, "\n")
          dat <- assemble_region_m6a(sample_names = sample_names, region_chr = ex$chrom,
            region_start = ex$window_start, region_end = ex$window_end,
            ft_result_dir = ft_result_dir, verbose = TRUE)
          stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dat$rids_df$RID),
                    identical(rownames(dat$met_mat), as.character(dat$rids_df$RID)))
          dat$rids_df$timepoint <- sample_table$timepoint[match(dat$rids_df$sample_name, sample_names)]
          dat$example <- ex
          saveRDS(dat, file.path(example_dir(ex), "pooled_m6a_extracted.rds"))
          print(head(dat$rids_df))
          cat(nrow(dat$met_mat), "pooled reads x", ncol(dat$met_mat), "m6A sites before filtering\n")
          counts <- dat$rids_df %>% count(sample_name, timepoint, name = "n_extracted_reads")
          counts$example_id <- ex$example_id
          counts$region_id <- ex$region_id
          input_summary[[i]] <- counts
          print(counts)
        }
        write_tsv(bind_rows(input_summary), file.path(tables_dir, "extracted_molecule_counts.tsv"))
        """)
        extracted_counts = pd.read_csv(tables_dir / "extracted_molecule_counts.tsv", sep="\t")
        display(extracted_counts.head())

    extract_pooled_m6a()

11. Run pooled Manhattan kNN and Leiden clustering¶

Next, we keep the project’s complete-call molecules and cluster each pooled region once without using timepoint as a feature.

In [86]:
if generate_example_plots:
    def cluster_pooled_molecules():
        run_r_stage("02_pooled_manhattan_leiden", r"""
        all_assignments <- list()
        run_summaries <- list()
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {
          ex <- examples[i, , drop = FALSE]
          dat <- readRDS(file.path(example_dir(ex), "pooled_m6a_extracted.rds"))
          stopifnot(identical(dat$example, ex))
          # Preserve filter_met_mat(): coverage at all observed m6A sites, then nonzero sites.
          met_mat <- filter_met_mat(dat$met_mat, verbose = TRUE)
          metadata <- dat$rids_df[match(rownames(met_mat), dat$rids_df$RID), , drop = FALSE]
          print(head(metadata))
          cat(ex$example_id, ":", nrow(met_mat), "retained reads x", ncol(met_mat), "sites\n")
          retained_counts <- table(factor(metadata$sample_name, levels = sample_names))
          print(retained_counts)
          if (any(retained_counts == 0L)) stop(ex$example_id, ": no retained molecules at a timepoint; do not substitute another region")
          if (nrow(met_mat) < 3L || ncol(met_mat) < 2L) stop("Too few reads/sites for ", ex$example_id)
          result <- leiden_manhattan_cluster(met_mat = met_mat, rids_df = metadata,
            region_start = ex$window_start, region_end = ex$window_end,
            window_size = window_size, k_neighbors = k_neighbors, resolution = leiden_resolution,
            impute_missing = impute_missing, impute_k = impute_k, sigma = kernel_sigma,
            seed = leiden_seed, verbose = TRUE)
          result$assignments$sample_name <- factor(result$assignments$sample_name, levels = sample_names)
          result$assignments$timepoint <- sample_table$timepoint[match(result$assignments$sample_name, sample_names)]
          result$assignments$region_id <- ex$region_id
          result$assignments$example_id <- ex$example_id
          result$assignments$direction <- ex$direction
          result$site_met_mat <- met_mat
          result$met_mat <- met_mat
          result$region <- data.frame(chr = ex$chrom, start = ex$window_start - 1L, end = ex$window_end,
            analysis_start = ex$window_start, analysis_end = ex$window_end,
            width = ex$window_end - ex$window_start + 1L, region_id = ex$region_id,
            annotation = region_title(ex), region_type = "differential_FIRE")
          result$example <- ex
          result$params$region_chr <- ex$chrom
          result$params$region_id <- ex$region_id
          result$params$coordinate_system <- "1-based inclusive"
          result$cluster_colors <- cluster_palette(levels(result$assignments$cluster))
          stopifnot(identical(rownames(result$feat_mat), result$assignments$RID),
                    setequal(igraph::V(result$graph)$name, result$assignments$RID))
          saveRDS(result, file.path(example_dir(ex), "pooled_leiden.rds"))
          show_reads(result)
          all_assignments[[i]] <- result$assignments
          run_summaries[[i]] <- data.frame(example_id = ex$example_id, region_id = ex$region_id,
            n_reads = nrow(result$assignments), n_features = ncol(result$feat_mat),
            n_clusters = result$n_clusters, k_eff = result$params$k_eff,
            n_edges = igraph::ecount(result$graph), sigma = result$params$sigma)
        }
        write_tsv(bind_rows(all_assignments), file.path(tables_dir, "molecule_cluster_assignments.tsv"))
        write_tsv(bind_rows(run_summaries), file.path(tables_dir, "pooled_leiden_run_summary.tsv"))
        print(bind_rows(run_summaries))
        """)
        molecule_assignments = pd.read_csv(tables_dir / "molecule_cluster_assignments.tsv", sep="\t")
        display(molecule_assignments[["region_id", "RID", "timepoint", "cluster"]].head())
        display(pd.read_csv(tables_dir / "pooled_leiden_run_summary.tsv", sep="\t"))

    cluster_pooled_molecules()

if generate_example_plots:
    def extract_feature_tracks():
        import json

        extract_script = project_root / "code/topic_model/read_region_extraction/extract_region_result_macrophage.sh"
        required_parsed = [
            "extracted.m6a.bed.gz", "extracted.m6a.bed.gz.tbi", "extracted.cpg.bed.gz",
            "extracted.cpg.bed.gz.tbi", "region.fiberhmm_tf.bed", "region.fiberhmm_footprint.bed",
            "fire_elements.bed", "fire_peaks.bed", "fire.bed",
        ]
        extraction_rows = []
        for ex in selected_examples.itertuples(index=False):
            region_string = f"{ex.chrom}:{ex.window_start}-{ex.window_end}"
            for sample_name in ("LPS_0", "LPS_5", "LPS_10", "LPS_15"):
                sample_dir = example_directory(ex.example_id) / sample_name
                parsed_dir = sample_dir / "parsed"
                stamp = sample_dir / "extraction_complete.json"
                signature = {"region": region_string, "sample": sample_name,
                             "script_mtime_ns": extract_script.stat().st_mtime_ns}
                complete = (stamp.exists() and json.loads(stamp.read_text()) == signature
                            and all((parsed_dir / name).exists() for name in required_parsed))
                if not complete:
                    print("Extracting", ex.example_id, sample_name, region_string, flush=True)
                    with subprocess.Popen(
                        ["bash", str(extract_script), sample_name, region_string,
                         example_directory(ex.example_id).name, str(example_root)],
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True,
                        env=r_environment,
                    ) as process:
                        for line in process.stdout:
                            print(line, end="", flush=True)
                        return_code = process.wait()
                    if return_code:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f"Feature extraction failed for {ex.example_id}/{sample_name} "
                            f"with exit status {return_code}; see notebook output above."
                        )
                    stamp.write_text(json.dumps(signature, indent=2) + "\n")
                extraction_rows.append({"example_id": ex.example_id, "sample_name": sample_name,
                                        "region": region_string, "parsed_dir": str(parsed_dir)})
        feature_extraction = pd.DataFrame(extraction_rows)
        feature_extraction.to_csv(tables_dir / "feature_extraction_manifest.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
        display(feature_extraction.head())
        print(f"Extracted feature sets: {len(feature_extraction)} ({len(selected_examples)} regions x {len(expected_timepoints)} timepoints)")

    extract_feature_tracks()

We match motif hits to plotted per-read TF footprints by at least 50% of the motif bases overlapping a single TF footprint, choose the hit supported by the most retained molecules, and rebuild all analyses in its ±500 bp window.

Footprints must score ≥50, be 10–80 bp long, and lie fully inside a FIRE element on the same molecule; genomic overlap does not identify the bound TF or establish occupancy. Ties use FIMO score, then coordinates and strand. Motif coordinates are 1-based inclusive; footprint BED starts are shifted by +1 before comparison.

The overlap fraction is intersection length / motif length (not reciprocal footprint coverage). The threshold is inclusive: overlap_bp >= 0.5 * motif_length. Change both filters in 03a_choose_motif_center and 03b_verify_center_overlap below together.

Anchor support uses only 0- and 15-minute molecules, matching the enrichment test; the example figures retain tracks for all four timepoints. Candidate motif hits must also satisfy the genome-wide ≥50% support filter used in enrichment.

if generate_example_plots:
    def load_molecule_tracks():
        run_r_stage("03_load_region_tracks", r"""
        track_counts <- list()
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {
          ex <- examples[i, , drop = FALSE]
          result <- read_result(ex)
          show_reads(result)
          tracks <- load_region_results(
            region = data.frame(chr = ex$chrom, start = ex$window_start, end = ex$window_end),
            sample_names = sample_names,
            result_dirs = file.path(example_dir(ex), sample_names, "parsed"),
            include_cpg = FALSE, fiberHMM_feature = "tf", min_fiberHMM_fp_score = 50,
            fiberHMM_size_breaks = c(10, 30, 60, 80), nucleosome_size_breaks = c(130, 160))
          missing <- setdiff(result$assignments$RID, as.character(tracks$rids_df$RID))
          if (length(missing)) stop(ex$example_id, ": ", length(missing),
            " clustered molecules lack plotting tracks; inspect extraction rather than dropping them")
          labels <- setNames(as.character(result$assignments$timepoint), result$assignments$RID)
          tracks <- add_read_groups(tracks, labels, "timepoint", group_levels = c("0", "5", "10", "15"))
          stopifnot(setequal(as.character(tracks$rids_df$RID), result$assignments$RID))
          saveRDS(tracks, file.path(example_dir(ex), "retained_molecule_tracks.rds"))
          counts <- data.frame(example_id = ex$example_id, region_id = ex$region_id,
            n_reads = nrow(tracks$rids_df), n_m6a_calls = nrow(tracks$reads),
            n_fire_segments = sum(tracks$fire$class == "FIRE"),
            n_nucleosome_footprints = nrow(tracks$nucs), n_tf_footprints = nrow(tracks$fps_infire))
          track_counts[[i]] <- counts
          print(head(tracks$rids_df)); print(head(tracks$fire)); print(counts)
        }
        write_tsv(bind_rows(track_counts), file.path(tables_dir, "molecule_track_counts.tsv"))
        """)
        display(pd.read_csv(tables_dir / "molecule_track_counts.tsv", sep="\t").head())

    load_molecule_tracks()

    run_r_stage("03a_choose_motif_center", '\n# Called on the initial FIRE-midpoint window; supports are unique retained molecules.\nhits <- read.delim(file.path(tables_dir, "example_motif_hits.tsv"), check.names = FALSE)\ncandidate_rows <- list(); overlap_rows <- list(); anchor_rows <- list()\nfor (i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {\n  ex <- examples[i, , drop = FALSE]\n  tracks <- readRDS(file.path(example_dir(ex), "retained_molecule_tracks.rds"))\n  fps <- tracks$fps_infire\n  fps <- fps[!is.na(fps$class) & fps$chr == ex$chrom & fps$sample_name %in% c("LPS_0", "LPS_15"), , drop = FALSE]\n  candidates <- hits[hits$example_id == ex$example_id & hits$motif_id == ex$selection_motif_id, , drop = FALSE]\n  stopifnot(nrow(candidates) > 0L)\n  candidates$n_overlapping_reads <- 0L\n  candidates$n_supporting_timepoints <- 0L\n  for (j in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {\n    motif <- candidates[j, , drop = FALSE]\n    # Motifs are 1-based closed; footprints are BED 0-based half-open.\n    overlap_bp <- pmin(fps$end, motif$end) - pmax(fps$start + 1L, motif$start) + 1L\n    fp <- fps[overlap_bp >= 0.5 * (motif$end - motif$start + 1L), , drop = FALSE]\n    candidates$n_overlapping_reads[j] <- length(unique(as.character(fp$RID)))\n    candidates$n_supporting_timepoints[j] <- length(unique(as.character(fp$sample_name)))\n    if (nrow(fp)) {\n      overlap_rows[[length(overlap_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(\n        example_id = ex$example_id, TF = ex$selection_TF, motif_id = motif$motif_id,\n        motif_start = motif$start, motif_end = motif$end, motif_strand = motif$strand,\n        RID = as.character(fp$RID), sample_name = as.character(fp$sample_name),\n        footprint_start = fp$start + 1L, footprint_end = fp$end,\n        footprint_score = fp$score, footprint_size = fp$size,\n        overlap_bp = overlap_bp[overlap_bp >= 0.5 * (motif$end - motif$start + 1L)])\n    }\n  }\n  candidates <- candidates[order(-candidates$n_overlapping_reads, -candidates$score,\n                                  candidates$start, candidates$end, candidates$strand), , drop = FALSE]\n  if (candidates$n_overlapping_reads[1] < 1L) stop("No footprint-supported motif for ", ex$selection_TF)\n  anchor <- candidates[1, , drop = FALSE]\n  center <- as.integer(floor((anchor$start + anchor$end) / 2))\n  examples$window_center[i] <- center\n  examples$window_start[i] <- center - 500L\n  examples$window_end[i] <- center + 500L\n  examples$anchor_motif_start[i] <- anchor$start\n  examples$anchor_motif_end[i] <- anchor$end\n  examples$anchor_motif_strand[i] <- anchor$strand\n  examples$anchor_support_reads_initial[i] <- anchor$n_overlapping_reads\n  examples$anchor_selection_rule[i] <- "max unique retained reads with >=50% of motif bases overlapping a single footprint; FIMO score then coordinates"\n  candidate_rows[[i]] <- candidates\n  anchor_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(example_id=ex$example_id, TF=ex$selection_TF,\n    motif_id=ex$selection_motif_id, motif_start=anchor$start, motif_end=anchor$end,\n    motif_strand=anchor$strand, support_reads_initial=anchor$n_overlapping_reads,\n    window_center=center, window_start=center-500L, window_end=center+500L)\n}\nstopifnot(all(examples$window_end - examples$window_start == 1000L), all(examples$window_start > 0L))\nwrite_tsv(bind_rows(candidate_rows), file.path(tables_dir,"motif_center_candidates.tsv"))\nwrite_tsv(bind_rows(overlap_rows), file.path(tables_dir,"initial_motif_footprint_overlaps.tsv"))\nwrite_tsv(bind_rows(anchor_rows), file.path(tables_dir,"motif_center_anchors.tsv"))\nwrite_tsv(examples, file.path(tables_dir,"selected_example_regions.tsv"))\nprint(bind_rows(anchor_rows))\n')
    selected_examples = pd.read_csv(tables_dir / 'selected_example_regions.tsv', sep='\t')
    assert selected_examples['window_end'].sub(selected_examples['window_start']).eq(1000).all()
    # Rebuild the molecule matrices and feature tracks for the final motif-centered windows.
    extract_pooled_m6a()
    cluster_pooled_molecules()
    extract_feature_tracks()
    load_molecule_tracks()
    run_r_stage("03b_verify_center_overlap", '\nfinal_rows <- list(); summary_rows <- list()\nfor (i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {\n  ex <- examples[i, , drop = FALSE]\n  tracks <- readRDS(file.path(example_dir(ex), "retained_molecule_tracks.rds"))\n  fps <- tracks$fps_infire\n  fps <- fps[!is.na(fps$class) & fps$chr == ex$chrom & fps$sample_name %in% c("LPS_0", "LPS_15"), , drop = FALSE]\n  overlap_bp <- pmin(fps$end, ex$anchor_motif_end) - pmax(fps$start + 1L, ex$anchor_motif_start) + 1L\n  fp <- fps[overlap_bp >= 0.5 * (ex$anchor_motif_end - ex$anchor_motif_start + 1L), , drop = FALSE]\n  stopifnot(nrow(fp) > 0L)\n  final_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(example_id=ex$example_id, TF=ex$selection_TF,\n    motif_id=ex$selection_motif_id, motif_start=ex$anchor_motif_start, motif_end=ex$anchor_motif_end,\n    RID=as.character(fp$RID), sample_name=as.character(fp$sample_name),\n    footprint_start=fp$start+1L, footprint_end=fp$end, footprint_score=fp$score,\n    footprint_size=fp$size, overlap_bp=overlap_bp[overlap_bp >= 0.5 * (ex$anchor_motif_end - ex$anchor_motif_start + 1L)])\n  summary_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(example_id=ex$example_id, TF=ex$selection_TF,\n    window_center=ex$window_center, window_start=ex$window_start, window_end=ex$window_end,\n    anchor_support_reads_final=length(unique(as.character(fp$RID))))\n}\nwrite_tsv(bind_rows(final_rows), file.path(tables_dir,"motif_footprint_overlaps.tsv"))\nwrite_tsv(bind_rows(summary_rows), file.path(tables_dir,"motif_center_final_support.tsv"))\nprint(bind_rows(summary_rows))\n')
    display(pd.read_csv(tables_dir / 'motif_center_final_support.tsv', sep='\t'))

Export the complete notebook to HTML¶

Here we export the complete notebook to HTML while leaving out any cells tagged hide-cell.

In [ ]:
from pathlib import Path
import nbformat
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from traitlets.config import Config

notebook_path = Path(
    "/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/code/fire_frequency/TF_enrichment.ipynb"
)
output_path = Path(
    "/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/docs/TF_enrichment.html"
)

# Read notebook
with notebook_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    notebook = nbformat.read(f, as_version=4)

# Convert notebook to HTML
config = Config()
config.TagRemovePreprocessor.enabled = True
config.TagRemovePreprocessor.remove_cell_tags = {"hide-cell"}
exporter = HTMLExporter(config=config)
html, resources = exporter.from_notebook_node(notebook)

# Save HTML
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output_path.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
print(output_path)
